defs.def: a particular way of doing sth 方法；办法；措施

ex.s: What was the unexpected outcome of the author’s teaching method?
ex.t: 作者的教学方法带来了什么意想不到的结果？

ex.s: To test a food processing method.
ex.t: 测试一种食品加工方法。

ex.s: Consider the best method to deliver your message.
ex.t: 考虑传递信息的最佳方法。

ex.s: To compare different kinds of seeding methods.
ex.t: 终于，我买了一些油画颜料。

ex.s: Part one concludes by introducing my suggested method for adopting this philosophy: the digital declutter.
ex.t: 第一部分最后介绍了我建议的践行这一理念的方法：数字清理。

ex.s: The methods of estimation.
ex.t: 估算的方法。

ex.s: The menu in this beautiful colonial house includes traditional Thai cuisine combined with modern cooking methods.
ex.t: 这座美丽的殖民风格宅邸里的菜单包括传统泰国菜与现代烹饪方法的结合。

ex.s: They adopt modern cooking methods.
ex.t: 它们采用现代烹饪方法。

ex.s: Invent new methods for controlling weeds.
ex.t: 发明控制杂草的新方法。

ex.s: That project, which I could complete from my sofa instead of in the burning heat of the desert, not only survived the lockdown but worked where traditional methods didn’t.
ex.t: 那个项目我可以坐在沙发上完成，而不必在沙漠的酷热中进行，它不仅在封锁期间存活了下来，而且在传统方法不起作用的地方发挥了作用。

ex.s: Such methods seem obvious, yet so often we just don’t think.
ex.t: 这些方法看起来显而易见，但我们往往就是想不到。

ex.s: A further explanation of the research methods.
ex.t: 对研究方法的进一步解释。

ex.s: Over the last seven years, most states have banned texting by drivers, and public service campaigns have tried a wide range of methods to persuade people to put down their phones when they are behind the wheel.
ex.t: 过去七年里，大多数州已禁止司机发短信，公益宣传用了多种方法说服人们开车时放下手机。

ex.s: Friends need to talk about their preferred methods of communication
ex.t: 朋友需要谈论他们偏好的沟通方式

ex.s: Other scientists may say scientific findings are true because they use “the scientific method.” But we can never actually agree on what that method is.
ex.t: 其他科学家可能说科学发现是真的，因为他们用了“科学方法”。但我们永远无法真正就那方法是什么达成一致。

ex.s: Recently a leading scientist said the scientific method was to avoid fooling oneself into thinking something is true that is not.
ex.t: 最近，一位顶尖科学家说，科学方法就是避免自欺欺人地相信不真实的东西。

ex.s: Each of these views has its value, but if the claim is that any one of these is the scientific method, then they all fail.
ex.t: 这些观点各有价值，但如果声称其中任何一个是唯一的科学方法，那么它们都不成立。

ex.s: In fact, the methods of science have varied between disciplines and across time.
ex.t: 事实上，科学的方法在不同学科和不同时期都有所不同。

ex.s: Scientists have bitterly argued about which methods are the best, and, as we all know, bitter arguments rarely get resolved.
ex.t: 科学家们激烈地争论哪些方法最好，而众所周知，激烈的争论很少能解决。

ex.s: What does the author think of the methods of science?
ex.t: 作者如何看待科学方法？

ex.s: They shouldn’t be limited to a single method.
ex.t: 它们不应局限于单一方法。

ex.s: Scientific Method: Simple Choice
ex.t: 科学方法：简单的选择

ex.s: Diverse methods were adopted during training.
ex.t: 训练过程中采用了多种不同的方法。

ex.s: An explanation of the research method.
ex.t: 对研究方法的说明。

ex.s: The standard method of conducting hypnosis.
ex.t: 进行催眠的标准方法。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: In Samarkand, Mr Bissell admires the architectural wonders, while on his way to Bukhara he gets a taste of police methods when suspected of drug dealing.
ex.t: 在撒马尔罕，比塞尔先生欣赏建筑奇观，而在前往布哈拉途中，他因涉嫌毒品交易尝到了警察手段的滋味。

ex.s: I decided to think up a method of dealing with forbidden fruit.
ex.t: 我决定想出一个方法 对付被禁止的水果。

ex.s: To explain her teaching method.
ex.t: 为了解释她的教学方法。

ex.s: A mathematical method.
ex.t: 一种数学方法。

ex.s: Basic Methods of Genetic ResearchD.
ex.t: 遗传研究的基本方法 D.

ex.s: The old methods still work today.
ex.t: 老方法今天仍然有效。

ex.s: At the core of Lancom is a world-class effective method that enhances language leaning with advanced technology.
ex.t: Lancom的核心是一种世界级的有效方法，借助先进技术提升语言学习。

ex.s: An effective method.
ex.t: 一种有效的方法。

ex.s: Modem methods   63   tracking polar bear populations have been employed only since the mid-1980s,and are expensive   64   (perform) consistently over a large area.
ex.t: ___63___追踪北极熊种群的现代方法从20世纪80年代中期才开始使用，而且在大范围上持续___64___（perform）成本高昂。

ex.s: To introduce a new method to study phytoplankton
ex.t: 介绍一种研究浮游植物的新方法

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 对于足球和篮球来说，效果不一：为球队增添有天赋的球员被证明是个好办法，但仅限于70%的球员都是顶尖人才的程度；超过这一水平，球队的表现就开始下滑。

ex.s: This method provided a readout for how home energy use has evolved since the early 1990s.
ex.t: 这种方法提供了自1990年代初以来家庭能源使用情况的读数。

ex.s: To explain a study method on worms.
ex.t: 为了解释一种关于蠕虫的研究方法。

ex.s: It took three years to complete and was built using an interesting method.
ex.t: 它花了三年时间才建成，并采用了一种有趣的建造方法。

ex.s: After you’ve tried a new method for a week, take a look at your record.
ex.t: 在尝试一种新方法一周后，看看你的记录。

ex.s: 40    If not, take another look at other methods you could try.
ex.t: 40    如果没有效果，再看看其他可以尝试的方法。

ex.s: This isn’t as hard as it    62   (sound), and it is far better than any other method because you improve your vocabulary while    63   (read) an interesting piece of literature.
ex.t: 这并不像它___62___（听起来）那么难，而且远比任何其他方法好，因为你在___63___（阅读）一篇有趣的文学作品时提高了词汇量。

ex.s: It took three years to complete and was built using an interesting method.
ex.t: 它花了三年时间才建成，并采用了一种有趣的建造方法。

ex.s: This educational method was first observed in 2012 by Sonia Kleindorfer, a biologist at Flinders University in South Australia, and her colleagues.
ex.t: 这种教育方法最早由南澳大利亚弗林德斯大学的生物学家索尼娅·克莱因多弗和她的同事于2012年观察到。

ex.s: To discuss methods to cure measles.
ex.t: 讨论治疗麻疹的方法。

ex.s: “I am ahead of my time.” If he seems a little defensive, it might be because even some of his coworkers occasionally laugh at his unusual methods.
ex.t: 我走在时代前面。”如果他显得有点戒备，或许是因为连他的一些同事偶尔也会嘲笑他那不寻常的方法。

ex.s: This knowledge is passed down through families, which means that new generations continue to use ancient methods of agriculture to maintain the terraces.
ex.t: 这些知识通过家庭传承，这意味着新一代人继续使用古老的农业方法来维护梯田。

ex.s: Today, local people use modern methods to maintain the terraces, and they attract lots of visitors from all over the country.
ex.t: 如今，当地人使用现代方法来维护梯田，它们吸引了来自全国各地的众多游客。

ex.s: Han Gan’s method, however, was different - he observed the animal itself.
ex.t: 然而，韩幹的方法不同——他观察动物本身。

ex.s: And the same method can be applied to the other senses.
ex.t: 同样的方法也可以应用于其他感官。

ex.s: “Wax is a complex mixture, but the basic bond in polyethylene, the carbon-carbon bond, is there as well,” she explains, “The wax worm evolved a method or system to break this bond.”
ex.t: “蜡是一种复杂的混合物，但聚乙烯中的基本键——碳碳键——也在其中，”她解释说，“蜡虫进化出了一种方法来破坏这种键。”
